confirmedFindings.title: In-place mutation of shared cached context reference permits cross-tenant data bleed
confirmedFindings.body: Mutating config.defaultDiscount in-place on the cached object reference returned by TenantContextStore permanently alters shared memory, leaking promotional pricing across tenants.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Deep clone or freeze cached configuration objects before returning them from TenantContextStore or avoid in-place property mutations.
